results.query: A loaded cart follows a completely visible path from fields through a real gap in the threshing-yard curb and onwards to the storehouse, with no buildings or figures hiding the path.
A drainage inspection photograph shows dry paving, the full open channel, its outlet lip, the short water stream and the lower wet receiving earth together.
An estate inspector points at the cart at the storehouse and the foreman looks at that exact cart while holding a plan below chest height.
Two petitioners put separate fingertips inside one enclosed parcel on a map on the same bank of a river, leaving the complete parcel boundary clear.
An estate map and an open bound register show the same river bend, bridge and closed parcel with all boundary endpoints visible; a straightedge lies on a blank margin.
A clerk writes a short visible ink stroke in the ruled entry of an open bound register; the pen tip touches the actual bound page while the other hand steadies that book.
At a communal bakehouse two people support one loaf with four separate hands. Each wrist and each real palm-to-loaf contact is visible with clear gaps between the hands.
Two people hold a mostly connected loaf with a tiny central fissure, a narrow pale crumb line and a broad intact lower crust bridge.
A modern city cafe, a barista pours espresso into a ceramic cup beside the coffee machine.
A lone commuter waits beneath a neon timetable on a contemporary train platform.
A simple photographic headshot with short dark hair and a plain background.
An empty coastal landscape with waves and rocks at sunrise.
